title: "Functions"
format: html

This script defines the helper functions used by the analysis scripts. Several stand in for sRtr functions that are planned but not yet written; each names the sRtr issue that will replace it. Every function is tested on synthetic data in `tests/testthat/test-functions.R`.

::: {.Rcode title="Source code"}
The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/functions.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-pancreas-2024-srtr/blob/main/R/functions.R)

This R script file is itself reliant on the following helper files:

-   [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-pancreas-2024-srtr/blob/main/R/setup.R)

The code sections below are imported directly from that script when this page is rendered.
:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
#| cache: false
knitr::read_chunk("../R/functions.R")
```

## Reading SRTR codes

sRtr labels coded values as "code: meaning". This function returns the numeric code from either form, so code lists can be matched against the SRTR formats whether or not the labels have been applied.

```{r}
#| label: srtr-code
#| eval: false
```

## Diagnosis group

Groups the primary diagnosis into type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes and other, using the codes in the plan. It will move to the planned sRtr code-grouping function ([sRtr#2](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/sRtr/issues/2)).

```{r}
#| label: diagnosis-group
#| eval: false
```

## Missing preservation time

Fills missing pancreas preservation time before the PDRI is calculated, by one of three rules.

**Decision pending:** which rule applies ([#10](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-pancreas-2024-srtr/issues/10)).

```{r}
#| label: impute-preservation-time
#| eval: false
```

## Center volume

Counts transplants per center per calendar year from a whole transplant file, optionally within a subgroup such as recipients with HIV, and groups the counts by cut-points. It will move to sRtr ([sRtr#52](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/sRtr/issues/52)).

```{r}
#| label: center-volume
#| eval: false
```

## Induction therapy

Flags, for each transplant, whether it received each class of induction drug.

**Decision pending:** which drugs count, and whether only drugs recorded as induction count ([#11](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-pancreas-2024-srtr/issues/11)). The function will move to sRtr ([sRtr#51](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/sRtr/issues/51)).

```{r}
#| label: induction-flags
#| eval: false
```

## Weights for the average effect among recipients with HIV

Inverse probability weights for the plan's estimand: 1 for recipients with HIV, and the propensity score divided by one minus it for recipients without HIV, with optional truncation.

**Decision pending:** stabilization and truncation ([#21](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-pancreas-2024-srtr/issues/21)).

```{r}
#| label: att-weights
#| eval: false
```

## Balance

Standardized mean differences between recipients with and without HIV, with or without weights, for each variable or each level of a categorical variable.

```{r}
#| label: weighted-smd
#| eval: false
```

Points of a Lorenz curve and the Gini coefficient for counts across transplant centers.

#| eval: false

## Follow-up dates

First rejection and malignancy dates from the follow-up files through sRtr, with the output columns fixed so they do not depend on which organs had a rejection ([sRtr#16](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/sRtr/issues/16)).
